topology.sharedDatabase: disposable PostgreSQL cluster (isolated_postgres; SQLite must not stand in for the cross-process row-lock proofs)

writeRepresentative.family: xianyu maintenance steps (legacy steps task, writeEffect=true by fail-closed default)
writeRepresentative.rationale: No real publish: the Companion is simulated by the test client and never executes a step against a real platform; Q03 real publishing is not used.

injectedFaults: tenant-conflict (same account write mutex across devices/processes)

acceptance.noSameDeviceDoubleWrite: each device holds at most one CLAIMED/RUNNING task and at most one live lease at any time, across both API processes
acceptance.noCrossTenantOrCrossDeviceCrosstalk: a binding never claims, reads, heartbeats, cancels or completes a task of another device or tenant
acceptance.parallelProgressWithIndependentCancel: device B progresses to SUCCEEDED while device A is disconnected or canceled; canceling A never touches B's task

deviceItems.reason: physical network partition after the gated intent commit requires real hardware (Android Companion + real transport); software simulation is covered by the lease-lapse and open-UNKNOWN tests

the on-device single-writer arbiter (Recipe/IME/remote gesture arbitration inside the Companion process) executes on Android and is not observable through the API; its API-side projection is the at-most-one-active-task-per-device invariant asserted here
